Rehman, Jingdong, & Hussain (2016) (rehman-2016-literacy-rate, diamond OA): publisher abstract verified; motivates examining provincial comparisons alongside national summaries; no outdated rates, rankings or causal economic claims asserted.

Ahmad (2011) (ahmad-2011-efa, diamond OA): verified via Seminar.net repository and OpenAlex W2791535578; documents historical obstacles to EFA in Pakistan and Dakar 2000 renewal with 2015 target horizon.

Shakir, Lone, & Zafar (2012) (shakir-2012-literacy-pk, diamond OA): verified via Semantic Scholar abstract; cautions that primary school completion alone does not establish demonstrated literacy level in Pakistan.

UNESCO (2017) (unesco-2017-inclusion): official publication overview and clearinghouse verified, definitions of equity and inclusion confirmed via UNESCO IBE Reaching Out to All Learners resource pack (p. 24); applied to analyze barriers to presence, participation and achievement.
MoFEPT (2018) (gop-2018-nep-framework): official ministry policies index verified; framework cited as dated policy commitment (participation, quality, skills) rather than achieved outcome.
UN SDG 4 (un-goal4): verified official UN DESA targets page; targets 4.1, 4.5, 4.6 distinguish primary/secondary completion, equity and youth/adult literacy with 2030 horizon.
UNESCO AI in education (unesco-ai-education): verified overview; emphasizes human-centred approach, inclusion, equity and caution against widening technological divides.
All classroom scenes, school proposals, and numerical examples are original invented teaching cases and explicitly labelled as such; no uncorroborated empirical claims asserted.

findings.message: Teaching case illustrations and hypothetical examples: Fictional classroom scenarios (Sana, Bilal, Hyderabad phone homework, Sukkur book fair, Mirpurkhas multi-grade rotation, Karachi homework, Hyderabad story app) are original instructional examples designed for pedagogy and do not represent empirical case studies or official school inspection records.

Headless review tooling constraint: The crew job brief explicitly prohibits running npm run build, a dev server, or Playwright Chromium. Visual, structural, and presentation checks were conducted within permitted host resources via measure-figure-text.mjs (all 8 SVG variants exit 0 with zero overflow or collision), static heading and table container analysis, and Sharp PNG rasterization with CSS variables resolved.

Abstract-level citation for Shakir et al. (2012) and Rehman et al. (2016): Citations are strictly limited to findings and scope reported in the published abstracts retrieved via Semantic Scholar and ScienceDirect.

Mapped reading context for Booth & Ainscow (2016): The print book was not accessible and carries no claim; inclusion and equity definitions are grounded in the verified UNESCO (2017) overview and UNESCO IBE resource pack.
